Add on any dip to +1.01% ID lag, targeting 5-8% catch-up in 4 weeks as global risk-on persists.

themes: Indonesia's EV adoption is structurally accelerating via government-mandated fleet electrification and local content requirements, directly benefiting VKTR's bus manufacturing and TOBA's nickel-batter

Structural tailwind from food-service and beverage sub-sectors (ADES, AGAR) reflects urbanization and premiumization trends, making them core holdings despite valuation premiums.
sectors.ai: Buy dips in consumer names with volume-confirmed breakouts (COIN, BTEK, SMLE) as ID outperformance persists; rotate from laggards into mid-cap staples with earnings catalysts. Watch ADES and AGAR for follow-through, but trim any position up >9% intraday to lock gains. Maintain WATCH bias, add on pullbacks to 5-day moving averages.
